key_insight: Discrete diffusion models can have an ODE-based formulation analogous to the probability flow ODE used in continuous diffusion. The paper introduces exponential residual flows (ERFs), which augment discrete states with a continuous residual variable.
problem_solved: Continuous diffusion has a deterministic ODE formulation that supports accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. This paper addresses whether a similar formulation can be built for discrete diffusion.
method: Introduce exponential residual flows as an ODE-based framework for discrete diffusion.
Augment each discrete state with a continuous residual variable.
Use the augmented representation to establish an analogue of continuous diffusion's probability flow ODE.
impact: The framework provides a foundation for exploring ODE-based sampling and distillation in discrete diffusion models. The supplied abstract excerpt does not establish specific speedups or benchmark results.
visual_elements: Side-by-side diagram: continuous diffusion → probability flow ODE; discrete diffusion → exponential residual flow.
Augmented-state illustration pairing a discrete token with a continuous residual gauge.
Trajectory sketch showing continuous evolution alongside changes in discrete state.
Application icons highlighting potential accelerated sampling and consistency distillation.
paper_title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
paper_authors: Samson Gourevitch, Yazid Janati, Eric Moulines, Eric P. Xing, Alain Durmus
